rubric: A one-word spelling fix in one string in one file: the lowest level of lines and of files, and one reviewer reads it at a glance.

criteria.reviewable: Could one reviewer read this as one pull request with one purpose and follow it in one sitting?

reading.why: One word in one string in one file: about 50 lines or fewer, 1 or 2 files, and a reviewer reads it at a glance.
